announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: BayWa AG: Preliminary announcement of the publication of financial reports according to Articles 114, 115, 117 of the WpHG [the German Securities Act]
announcements.insight: BayWa AG publishes financial reports as required by German law. This follows earlier restructuring agreements reached in June and September 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: BayWa AG: Preliminary announcement of the publication of financial reports according to Articles 114, 115, 117 of the WpHG [the German Securities Act]
announcements.insight: BayWa AG publishes financial reports per German Securities Act Articles 114, 115, 117. This follows the September agreement on a restructuring term sheet.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: BayWa AG: Agreement reached on term sheet for adjusted restructuring agreement; restructuring of hybrid bond planned
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a significant restructuring of the company's capital structure through an adjusted agreement and hybrid bond modification. Such actions are critical for shareholders as they often signal efforts to stabilize finances or address solvency concerns.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: BayWa AG: Understanding in principle on a concept for adjusting the restructuring agreement with key creditors and major shareholders
announcements.insight: BayWa AG reached an in-principle understanding with key creditors and major shareholders to adjust its restructuring agreement. This marks a significant step in resolving its financial position.
